name: Hosokawa Sayoko
source:
Commander of the Hosokawa Imperial Guard Division, the central division of the Rokukyō Families in the Mizuho Imperial State.
Current head of the Hosokawa Family, one of the Rokukyō.
She serves as Supreme Commander of the “Northern Army”, organized in response to the second invasion by the Great Empire of Ivan.

Her intellectual and graceful manner befits her noble lineage.
On the battlefield, she demonstrates foresightful cunning and the decisiveness to carry it out, making her regarded as one of the Mizuho Imperial State’s foremost strategists.

During the First Mizuho–Ivan War three years earlier, she commanded the Hosokawa Imperial Guard Division.
She herself piloted one of the newly deployed Mechanical Armour of the Rokukyō Families, fighting on the front lines.

“When this war is over, I would like to share a drink with you, just the two of us.”

[From [url=http://tech-gj.jp/products/hyakki/chara/index.html#hosokawa]official website[/url]]
